overview: The leave management system consists of three components: a React frontend (leave-portal) that employees and managers use to interact with the system, a Go-based backend API (leave-service) that handles all business logic for leave requests and balances, and a scheduled task (leave-balance-sync) that periodically synchronizes leave balances. The frontend communicates with the backend via REST API, and all components are containerized for Kubernetes deployment.
requirements: Employees must be able to submit leave requests with start date, end date, and leave type
Employees must be able to view their current leave balance for each leave type
Employees must be able to view the status of their submitted leave requests (pending, approved, rejected)
Managers must be able to view pending leave requests from their direct reports
Managers must be able to approve or reject leave requests with optional comments
The system must distinguish between employee and manager roles
The system must maintain leave balances per employee per leave type
All API endpoints must include health checks for monitoring
Leave balance data must be synchronized periodically

components.name: leave-service
components.openAPISpec:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Leave Management API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Backend API for managing employee leave requests and balances
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Health check endpoint
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Service is healthy
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status:
                    type: string
                    example: ok
  /api/v1/employees/{employeeId}/leave-balance:
    get:
      summary: Get leave balance for an employee
      parameters:
        - name: employeeId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Leave balance retrieved successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  employeeId:
                    type: string
                  balances:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        leaveType:
                          type: string
                        available:
                          type: number
                        used:
                          type: number
        '404':
          description: Employee not found
  /api/v1/leave-requests:
    post:
      summary: Submit a new leave request
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required:
                - employeeId
                - startDate
                - endDate
                - leaveType
              properties:
                employeeId:
                  type: string
                startDate:
                  type: string
                  format: date
                endDate:
                  type: string
                  format: date
                leaveType:
                  type: string
                  enum: [annual, sick, personal, unpaid]
                reason:
                  type: string
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Leave request created successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  requestId:
                    type: string
                  status:
                    type: string
                    enum: [pending]
        '400':
          description: Invalid request data
    get:
      summary: Get leave requests (filtered by employeeId or managerId)
      parameters:
        - name: employeeId
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
          description: Filter by employee who submitted the request
        - name: managerId
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
          description: Filter by manager (returns requests from direct reports)
        - name: status
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [pending, approved, rejected]
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Leave requests retrieved successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    requestId:
                      type: string
                    employeeId:
                      type: string
                    employeeName:
                      type: string
                    startDate:
                      type: string
                      format: date
                    endDate:
                      type: string
                      format: date
                    leaveType:
                      type: string
                    reason:
                      type: string
                    status:
                      type: string
                      enum: [pending, approved, rejected]
                    submittedAt:
                      type: string
                      format: date-time
                    reviewedBy:
                      type: string
                    reviewedAt:
                      type: string
                      format: date-time
                    reviewComment:
                      type: string
  /api/v1/leave-requests/{requestId}:
    get:
      summary: Get a specific leave request by ID
      parameters:
        - name: requestId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Leave request retrieved successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  requestId:
                    type: string
                  employeeId:
                    type: string
                  employeeName:
                    type: string
                  startDate:
                    type: string
                    format: date
                  endDate:
                    type: string
                    format: date
                  leaveType:
                    type: string
                  reason:
                    type: string
                  status:
                    type: string
                    enum: [pending, approved, rejected]
                  submittedAt:
                    type: string
                    format: date-time
                  reviewedBy:
                    type: string
                  reviewedAt:
                    type: string
                    format: date-time
                  reviewComment:
                    type: string
        '404':
          description: Leave request not found
  /api/v1/leave-requests/{requestId}/review:
    post:
      summary: Approve or reject a leave request
      parameters:
        - name: requestId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required:
                - managerId
                - action
              properties:
                managerId:
                  type: string
                action:
                  type: string
                  enum: [approve, reject]
                comment:
                  type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Leave request reviewed successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  requestId:
                    type: string
                  status:
                    type: string
                    enum: [approved, rejected]
        '400':
          description: Invalid review action
        '404':
          description: Leave request not found
components.componentAgentInstructions: Implement a Go backend service using net/http on port 9090. Use an in-memory data structure (map) to store leave requests and employee balances. Initialize with sample data for at least 3 employees and 2 managers. Each employee should have initial leave balances (annual: 20 days, sick: 10 days, personal: 5 days, unpaid: 0 days). When a leave request is submitted, validate that startDate is before endDate and that the dates are not in the past. Generate a unique requestId (UUID). Store the request with status 'pending'. When a manager reviews a request, verify the request exists and is in pending status. Update the status to approved or rejected, record the managerId, timestamp, and optional comment. If approved, deduct the days from the employee's leave balance for that type. Implement GET /api/v1/leave-requests with filtering by employeeId (returns all requests by that employee) or managerId (returns all pending requests from the manager's direct reports - maintain a simple map of manager to employee relationships). Support optional status filter. Implement GET /api/v1/employees/{employeeId}/leave-balance to return current balances. Return proper HTTP status codes: 200 for success, 201 for creation, 400 for bad requests, 404 for not found. Include CORS headers to allow requests from the frontend. Implement /health endpoint returning {"status":"ok"}. Use structured logging. Handle errors gracefully with appropriate JSON error responses.

            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status:
                    type: string
                    example: ok
components.componentAgentInstructions: Implement a React single-page application using TypeScript and React 18+. Use Create React App or Vite as the build tool. The application should serve on port 3000 during development and be production-built for static hosting. Implement the following pages: 1) Login/Role Selection page - simple form to select role (employee or manager) and enter an ID (no real authentication needed, just role simulation). Store the role and userId in React context or state. 2) Employee Dashboard - displays current leave balances fetched from GET /api/v1/employees/{employeeId}/leave-balance. Show a form to submit new leave requests with date pickers for start/end dates, dropdown for leave type (annual, sick, personal, unpaid), and optional reason text area. On submit, POST to /api/v1/leave-requests. Below the form, display a table of the employee's leave requests fetched from GET /api/v1/leave-requests?employeeId={id} showing date range, type, status, and any review comments. Use color coding for status (yellow=pending, green=approved, red=rejected). 3) Manager Dashboard - displays a table of pending leave requests from direct reports fetched from GET /api/v1/leave-requests?managerId={id}&status=pending. Each row should have Approve and Reject buttons. Clicking either opens a modal with an optional comment field, then POSTs to /api/v1/leave-requests/{requestId}/review with action and comment. After successful review, refresh the list. Implement client-side routing using React Router. Use fetch or axios to call the leave-service API. Configure the API base URL via environment variable (default to http://localhost:9090). Include error handling with user-friendly messages. Use a simple CSS framework like Tailwind CSS or Material-UI for styling. Implement a /health endpoint in the served static app that returns {"status":"ok"} for Kubernetes health checks. Use functional components and hooks throughout.

components.name: leave-balance-sync
components.openAPISpec:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Leave Balance Sync Job
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Scheduled task for synchronizing leave balances
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Health check endpoint
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Job is healthy
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status:
                    type: string
                    example: ok
components.componentAgentInstructions: Implement a Go program that runs as a Kubernetes CronJob. The program should execute once and then exit (suitable for cron scheduling). On execution, it should: 1) Log the start of the sync process. 2) Make an HTTP GET request to the leave-service at /api/v1/leave-requests to fetch all approved leave requests. 3) For each approved request, log the employee ID and leave type. 4) Simulate a balance synchronization by logging 'Synchronized balance for employee {employeeId}, type {leaveType}'. In a real system this would update an external HR system or database, but for this implementation just log the action. 5) Log completion with a count of synchronized records. 6) Exit with status code 0 on success, non-zero on failure. Include error handling for API calls with retries (up to 3 attempts with exponential backoff). Use structured logging with timestamp and log level. The program should read the leave-service URL from an environment variable LEAVE_SERVICE_URL (default: http://leave-service:9090). Implement a /health endpoint on port 9090 for pre-execution health checks, but the main logic should be in a separate function that runs once and exits.
